attchmntText: Technocraft Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording of the discussion on the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, at the analyst meet held on November 19, 2026, is available on the website of the Company
voiceSummary: Technocraft Ventures Limited disclosed the audio recording of the earnings conference call for the second quarter of the fiscal year 2026-27. The call was held on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 03:00 PM IST. It discussed the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended on September 30, 2026. The recording is available on the company website at https://www.technocra ventures.com/earnings-call-transcript. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015. The company secretary and compliance officer, Shefali Kesarwani, signed the communication.

attchmntText: Technocraft Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of Earnings Conference call on Financial Performance of the company for the second Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Technocraft Ventures Limited has scheduled an earnings conference call to discuss financial performance for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call is set for November 19, 2026, at 03:00 P.M. IST. The company confirms that no unpublished price sensitive information will be discussed. The schedule is subject to change. Details are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report issued by CARE Ratings Limited, ( Monitoring Agency ), in respect to the utilization of proceeds raised through issuance of equity shares by way of the Initial Public Offer ( IPO ) of the Company, for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Technocraft Ventures Limited filed a Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of proceeds from its Initial Public Offer of Rs. 201.51 crore. The report was issued by CARE Ratings Limited and reviewed by the Audit Committee and Board of Directors on November 14, 2026. The Monitoring Agency confirmed that all IPO proceeds were utilized in accordance with the Offer Document objectives, with no deviations reported. The company utilized Rs. 139.98 crore out of the Rs. 150.00 crore allocated for working capital requirements during the quarter. The Board noted that these funds were deployed to secure competitive discounts on raw material procurement. The report is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Technocraft Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Press Release with respect to Consolidated and Standalone Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 ".
voiceSummary: Technocraft Ventures Limited filed press release regarding Consolidated and Standalone Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported H1 FY27 operating income of Rs. 192.98 crore, up 27.82 percent from Rs. 150.98 crore in H1 FY26. EBITDA increased by 40.98 percent to Rs. 37.91 crore from Rs. 26.89 crore. Profit after tax rose 39.51 percent to Rs. 21.70 crore from Rs. 15.55 crore. The company received a Letter of Award for contracts valued at Rs. 19646.80 lakhs excluding GST for sewer line works in Bawana AC. Sanjay Tyagi, Managing Director, DIN 01446861, signed the filing on September 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Technocraft Ventures Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Technocraft Ventures Limited has approved its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 14, 2026, following a recommendation by the Audit Committee. The statutory auditors, M/s. Rishi Kapoor & Company, have issued an Independent Auditor's Review Report on the financial statements. The report states that nothing has come to their attention to suggest material misstatements in the results prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standard 34. The consolidated results include the parent company and an associate partnership firm. The associate firm, TESPL-LRS-TCPL JV, has a 26% interest held by the parent. The parent company did not review the interim financial results of this associate, which reflect total revenue of Rs 2625.96 Lakhs and Rs 1917.54 Lakhs for the half year and quarter ended September 30, 2026, respectively. The results are available on the company website.
